integrity: Finite exact diagnostics accompany a complete symbolic proof; they are not substituted for infinite-parameter verification.
limitations: Cactus graphs only; no claim for arbitrary overlapping cycles
Only pairwise vertex-connectivity correlation, not general positive association of all increasing events
Strictness requires all fugacities positive and finite
Historical-priority comparison is not an independent validation
title: Positive connectivity correlations on every weighted cactus random-cluster graph
